bullets: Cut release regression from ~6 hours to minutes by building a Newman pipeline that runs QA Postman collections automatically as part of the release process, on a cloud-native IAM platform serving 130M+ subscribers across 150+ integrated systems.
Drove the team's AI-native shift — owned the automation harness, ran PoCs for multi-agent pipelines with quality gates, and led engineering training to drive adoption.
Reduced release-validation time from 2 hours to 5 minutes by eliminating a redundant DB schema-diff pipeline and consolidating checks into the main upgrade workflow.
Reduced flaky failures across 3 customer-facing release pipelines and 20 microservices by diagnosing pod failures and hardening stages with stable retries, health checks, and extended timeouts.
Cut manual reporting ~80% by building an agentic pipeline that aggregates data from Grafana, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and logs into automated stability reports.
Led end-to-end planning and delivery of a mission-critical migration of a legacy enterprise VCS to Git, involving IT, QA, and senior VPs.
Rescued 20+ years of production source code — 200,000+ files across hundreds of repositories — from an unstable legacy VCS.

Built migration pipelines against the system's proprietary SDK to extract repository structure, history, tags, and permissions, with full integrity validation — zero data loss across 700,000+ commits.
Integrated the migrated repositories into Azure CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated build and deployment for the newly transferred codebase.
